name: Copperleaf Pets
description: Pet supplies retailer with 8 stores in the fictional region of Lowmarsh.

items.title: Published welfare inspection result
items.content: Copperleaf published that a welfare inspection on 2026-06-30 found overcrowded hamster enclosures in one store; 23 animals were rehomed and the store passed re-inspection. Grooming prices are unchanged. Notice CP-GRM-4.

items.title: Adoption days
items.content: Rescue partner Lowmarsh Paws holds adoption days in the Marlow Street store on the last Sunday of each month, 11:15 to 15:05. Poster CP-ADO-8.

items.title: Live animal care routine
items.content: Fish tanks are tested daily at 08:40; ammonia above 0.25 ppm means the tank is closed for sale. Care lead: Imogen Fairlie. Routine CP-LAC-91.

items.title: Staff pet food allowance
items.content: Staff get one free 12 kg bag of dry food a month and 33.5% off other items. Logged in CP-SPF-24.

items.title: Pet food recall cost
items.content: The salmonella recall of own-brand kibble lot 2607-K cost $214,000; supplier Brannick Feeds has agreed to cover 60%. The cause will not be published. Memo CP-RC-2607-B.

items.title: Veterinary clinic partnership
items.content: Copperleaf will open vet clinics inside 3 stores with partner Halbury Vets from 2027-05-03; Copperleaf takes 12.75% of clinic revenue. Plan CP-VET-0503-H.
